id: title:Gilbert09:paginate aggregation endpoints via filter cursor not skip

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Pendo warehouse-source connector support, including pagination and filter escaping.
review.reason: The chunk implements a Pendo warehouse-source connector. P1.F1.H3 replaces unsupported skip/offset pagination with a filter-based cursor, addressing a compatibility constraint. P1.F1.H2 adds necessary string escaping for Pendo's filter grammar. P1.F1.H1 adds state for pagination resumption. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement for the Pendo warehouse ingestion path
review.uncertainty: No runtime or test execution; no evidence of actual Pendo API compatibility or complete connector implementation. No adoption or incident avoidance observed.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete Pendo warehouse-source change. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort metrics are supplied. No tier assignment is performed; only observations are returned.

observations.behavior: Adds PendoResumeConfig.last_id and PendoResumeConfig.offset; PendoResumeConfig is a resume state container.
observations.posthog_connection: Pendo aggregation endpoint lacks a skip/offset stage; PendoResumeConfig stores the last row's sort-field value to resume pagination without a skip step.

observations.behavior: Adds _escape_filter_string to escape backslashes and quotes before embedding a value into a Pendo filter expression.
observations.posthog_connection: Pendo's filter grammar uses JS-style string literals; unescaped quotes could break the filter expression and alter query behavior.

observations.behavior: Replaces pipeline's skip/offset stage with a filter cursor: visitorId>"last_id". Pendo's skip stage returns 400.
observations.posthog_connection: Pendo aggregation pipeline does not support skip; pagination must use a filter cursor on the sort field instead of skip/offset.
